reasons.author: pixel-SESW
reasons.why: Rear boot cuff (mauve) ran to the ground row; plum_0 sole so it reads as boot, consistent with f11

reasons.author: AD-xcheck
reasons.why: AD style lock: in 3/4 the far eye never carries a catchlight. This snow_3 sat against the silhouette outline as a white notch and blinked (absent in f7/f11); same defect pixel-EW fixed in W f12.

reasons.author: AD-xcheck
reasons.why: AD style lock: mouth must sit 1 row below the eye bottom and touch neither eye, scarf nor outline (S f12 rule). In 3/4 smile there is no such pixel, so the mouth is omitted, as in 3/4 f7/f8/f10. It read as a smear on the eye.
